rules.title: HOW TO PLAY
rules.intro: Durak (Дурак) is one of Russia's most beloved card games. Simple to learn, rich in strategy — the last player with cards is the fool.
rules.goalBody: Be the first player to play all cards from your hand. The last player left holding cards is the Durak (fool).
rules.rankingBody:
Cards rank from lowest to highest: 6 · 7 · 8 · 9 · 10 · J · Q · K · A

The trump suit beats any non-trump card, regardless of rank. Within the same suit, higher rank wins.
rules.attackingBody:
Open with any card. Other non-defenders may throw in cards matching any rank already on the table (attack or defense).

Caps: at most 5 attacking cards until the first successful discard, then 6 — and never more than the defender held when the bout began.
rules.defendingBody: Cover each attack with a higher card of the same suit, or any trump vs a non-trump. A trump is beaten only by a higher trump.
rules.takingBody: Press TAKE when you will not cover every attack. Attackers may still throw in matching ranks afterward (within the same caps). Then you pick up the whole table and skip the next attack — play passes to your left.
rules.transferBody:
Before covering anything, play a card of the same rank to pass the uncovered pile to the next player. They may transfer again the same way.

Same-rank throw-ins keep the transfer window open; any defense closes it. The next player must hold enough cards for the pile after your transfer.

By default, transfers are off until the first successful discard (первый ход не переводят).
rules.endRoundBody: After a beat or take, refill to 6: attacker first, then others clockwise, defender last. If the defender took, they skip the draw. Once the deck is empty, no draws occur.
rules.winningBody: A player leaves once their hand and the deck are empty. The last player with cards is the Durak. If nobody holds cards, the round is a draw.
rules.houseBody: Throw-in scope can be All players or Neighbors only. Trump-6 ↔ face-up trump swap is not used. Partnership teams are not supported.
rules.abilitiesBody:
When playing With Abilities, you have three extra powers:

• Return card — after you play a card (attack, defend, or transfer), tap Return within 3 seconds to take it back. AI opponents wait during this window.

• Graveyard — tap GRAVE anytime to see every card that has left play (successfully beaten pairs in the discard pile), sorted by suit.

• Reveal — on your turn, if an opponent holds 2+ cards, tap REVEAL. In 3–6 player games, choose the player first. Tap one of their face-down cards to peek at it for a few seconds. Unlimited uses while eligible.
rules.footer: Good luck — and don't be the Durak!
